title: Development-only hot reload around normal W units
question: Can a development runner rebuild and reopen normal W units, then switch an immutable snapshot or typed service generation with bounded drain, without adding a language feature or production dynamic mode?

production reload, active-frame mutation, arbitrary eval, and unsafe unload

recommendation: Treat hot reload as a development-only tooling runner. Rebuild and reopen normal W units, then compose existing REPL snapshots and typed service/plugin generations with prepare, validate, preflight, ready, switch, old-generation drain, and stale-event rejection. Keep generated module sets as SYN1 Research and keep CLI spelling tooling-owned until a separate gate justifies it.
stopCondition: Do not add language syntax, a source/package dev profile, or production dynamic mode. Stop on stale publication, hidden capability, live-state migration, cleanup/leak/unbounded resource, local/split logical divergence, invalid identity or source map, forged rollback, unknown fault without explicit outcome, post-publication rollback, native sandbox claim, or any missing compiler/provider/isolation evidence. W-1398/W-1399 remain Research until independent case review and implementation evidence close their named gates.
